description: Step out of executor mode and do a divergent, generative reflection pass: recombine across your separate worlds (projects, investing, writing and reading, the people you know) to surface connections and ideas no single task asked for, then consolidate the keepers into memory. Use when you say "dream", "go dream on this", "/dream", or ask for a dream after a chunk of work. Like sleep: recombine and consolidate.
